# Support

This is a personal portfolio repository, not a product. However, questions and feedback are welcome.

## How to Get Help

- **Questions about my contributions or projects** — open an [Issue](https://github.com/faisalaffan/foss-contribution/issues)
- **Corrections or updates** — submit a [Pull Request](https://github.com/faisalaffan/foss-contribution/pulls)
- **Direct contact** — reach out via [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/faisalaffan/foss-contribution/discussions) if enabled

## Response Time

This is a side project. Expect responses within a few days.
